in_marathi.name: Ramanna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ramanna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ramanna is derived from the name Rama, which means 'God of Abundance' or 'Protector'. The suffix '-anna' means 'little' or 'young'. Thus, Ramanna can be translated as 'Little Ram'.
